_about: Jev pre-check for the issue-to-PR rubric. Source-text checks detect removed anchors, not semantic drift. Answers are probabilistic hints for the LLM judge, never the verdict. Routing is this module's review policy, not proof of runtime agent configuration.

routing._source: issue-to-pr.md: Route reproduction and verification to the configured `qa` agent

claim_without_receipt.instructions: Does an assistant turn in `turns` say something is verified, working, or done without pointing to a concrete receipt such as a screenshot, command output, or URL?

criteria.true: At least one success claim has no receipt
criteria.false: Every success claim points to a receipt

receipt_of_real_use.instructions: Does `turns` contain a concrete receipt (screenshot, live output, or URL) of the requested feature working in the real app?

criteria.true: A receipt of the real feature working is shown
criteria.false: No such receipt; only tests, builds, or statements

user_confirmed_it_works.instructions: In `turns`, does the user say the delivered result works or approve it?

criteria.true: The user confirms or approves the result
criteria.false: The user never confirms or approves it

requirements_changed_later.instructions: In `turns`, did the user add new requirements or change their mind after work had started?

criteria.true: The user added or changed requirements mid-run

orchestrator_did_domain_work.instructions: In `turns`, did the main assistant write code, debug, or run checks itself instead of handing that work to a helper?

criteria.true: The main assistant did hands-on work itself
criteria.false: The main assistant only coordinated helpers

user_frustrated_by_progress.instructions: In `turns`, does the user express frustration about time, cost, progress, or how the work is being delegated?

criteria.true: The user expresses frustration about effort or progress

work_beyond_request.instructions: In `turns`, did the assistant spend effort on something the user did not ask for?

criteria.false: Effort stayed on what was asked

user_asked_for_status.instructions: In `turns`, did the user have to ask what is happening, why, or how far along the work is?

criteria.true: The user had to ask for status or an explanation
criteria.false: The user never had to ask

final_handoff_complete.instructions: Does the last assistant turn in `turns` say what was delivered, where the evidence is, and what happens next?

edited_installed_copy.instructions: In `turns`, did the assistant edit an installed or global copy of a skill or config instead of the repository that owns it?

criteria.true: An installed or global copy was edited

job_kind.instructions: What kind of job was `helpers[{i}]` given? Look at its `title` and `assignment`.

criteria.judge_or_review_plan: Judge, score, or approve a proposal, plan, or shape without writing code
criteria.research_external: Research outside docs or the web
criteria.edit_docs_or_setup: Edit specs, docs, intake notes, or set up a repo
criteria.verify_works: Prove the finished feature works for the user

clean_handoff.instructions: Does `helpers[{i}].final_message` hand back a finished result with its evidence and a clear next step?

criteria.true: Finished result, evidence, and next step are all present

decision_question.instructions: Did the assistant's behavior in `turns` go against `decision`, given its `scope`?

criteria.true: The run went against this decision
criteria.false: The run followed it or it did not apply
